ceiling_rule: the maximum, over every null construction, every replicate, every site other than the structurally-zero integrity site, and every layer, of the upper 95 percent cluster-bootstrap bound
claim_ceiling: An item-validity determination. It is not a scientific finding.

harness_positive_control.why: patching the differing positions at the embedding output makes the recipient run token-identical to the donor run, so restoration must be 1; this certifies the instrument without assuming anything about the model

integrity.why: causal masking makes donor and recipient states identical before the first differing token, so patching there must move nothing; a non-zero value here means the harness is writing something it should not
